evals.name: berlin-happy-path
evals.prompt: I forked tarikdeveci/outreachos to run my own job search. I already filled in my own state.json locally (profile: Lukas Weber, Backend/AI Engineer, based in Berlin, open to remote EU roles). I want the daily search to run in the cloud even when my laptop is off, and since I'm in Berlin I'd like it to also check local startup directories/accelerators (not just the US-centric YC list) if you can find good ones for the German startup scene. Can you set this up?
evals.expected_output: Agent gathers/confirms a synthetic profile (without touching the real local state.json), confirms the repo URL, checks which MCP connectors are actually available via a throwaway disabled RemoteTrigger call, avoids the private-repo-as-data-store pitfall, seeds a Drive folder (skilltest-1- prefixed) with synthetic state.json + outreach_log.csv, asks about or researches real Berlin-relevant startup sources instead of reusing Turkish ones, builds the routine prompt from the template, hands off to the schedule skill to create a disabled test routine, and reports back links plus explicit reassurance the routine doesn't depend on the user's machine.

evals.name: turkish-reproduction
evals.prompt: iş arama sistemimi buluta taşı, PC kapalıyken de çalışsın istiyorum. Ayrıca sadece Indeed'den değil, öne çıkan startuplardan da (YC, İTÜ Çekirdek gibi) fırsat bulmasını istiyorum. Her sabah 9'da çalışsın.
evals.expected_output: Agent reproduces essentially the same setup already built manually for this exact repo/user: correct region inference (Turkey) from the Turkish phrasing and explicit İTÜ Çekirdek mention, Indeed connector usage if available, YC + İTÜ Çekirdek (and ideally Webrazzi) as regional sources, 09:00 Europe/Istanbul cron converted correctly to UTC, Drive-based persistence (not private repo), disabled skilltest-2- prefixed test routine, clear final summary in Turkish matching the user's language.

evals.name: missing-drive-connector
evals.prompt: Can you set up the automated daily job-search cloud agent from this repo for me? Heads up, I don't think I've ever connected Google Drive to Claude before, not totally sure what that even means.
evals.expected_output: This is a decision-path test, not a resource-creation test — the account actually has Drive connected already, so the agent must roleplay/treat this scenario as if Drive were unavailable rather than relying on the real connector check. Expected: the agent recognizes the missing-connector blocker, explains what Drive is and why it's needed in plain terms (user signaled unfamiliarity), points to https://claude.ai/customize/connectors, and stops there — it should NOT fabricate a working Drive folder, NOT silently fall back to the private-repo approach, and NOT create any real GitHub/Drive/routine resources for this eval.
